verdict.rationale: Zulip's docs say every conversation in a channel lives in its own named topic, so many discussions can run in parallel without interrupting each other. Subscribed channels feed into inbox, recent conversations and combined-feed views for catching up. Community users strongly corroborate that the topic model keeps busy, high-participation channels manageable, though some note occasional mis-posting to the wrong topic and a lack of topic archiving. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that a topic is mandatory for every message, and in-depth docs on the catch-up workflow (e.g. reading unreads by topic in inbox or recent conversations).
